canonical.then: Scoped DENY/no count leakage

proposed.stimulus: Customer-Y attempts list/detail/count of cargo IDs
proposed.dbOracle: Scoped DENY/no count leakage; no hidden unit/mass overwrite or cross-customer record
proposed.eventOracle: No cross-customer export; committed unit IDs/digests cannot be replayed into second logical cargo result
proposed.uiOracle: Correct validation/authorization response, no false success; typed validation/403/409 as appropriate
proposed.mandatoryNegativeCheck: Validate units/quantity, WGS84 coordinates if present, versioned classification and unknown compliance as HOLD.
